# Skateboard Simulator - Feature Description

## Overview

The Skateboard Simulator script is a comprehensive automation tool for the Roblox game Skateboard Simulator. Built with the Nozomi UI library, it provides a modern, user-friendly interface for automating gameplay tasks including power training, zone management, egg opening, and pet crafting.

## Core Features

### 🎯 Main Tab Features

#### Power Training System
- **Power Level Selection**: Choose power level from 1-4 via dropdown
- **Auto Train**: Automatically trains your power level in the selected zone
- **Optimized Performance**: Fast execution with minimal delays for maximum efficiency

#### Zone Management
- **Dynamic Zone Detection**: Automatically detects all available zones in the game
- **Manual Zone Selection**: Dropdown menu with all available zones
- **Auto Detect Zone**: Intelligent zone detection based on player position
  - Automatically updates when you move between zones
  - Works with transparent/non-hittable boundary parts
  - Handles overlapping zones by prioritizing higher zone numbers
  - Updates UI dropdown in real-time

#### Game Automation
- **Auto Win**: Automatically wins games with maximum score (99,999,999)
- **Auto Rebirth**: Automatically performs rebirths when available
- **Optimized Loop**: All actions execute with minimal wait times for maximum speed

### 🥚 Eggs Tab Features

#### Zone Management for Eggs
- **Egg Zone Selection**: Separate zone dropdown for egg operations
- **Auto Detect Egg Zone**: Automatically detects current zone for egg opening
  - Same intelligent detection as main tab
  - Updates egg list when zone changes
  - Real-time UI synchronization

#### Egg Opening System
- **Dynamic Egg List**: Automatically populates egg names based on selected zone
- **Egg Name Selection**: Dropdown with all available eggs in the current zone
- **Auto Open Egg**: Continuously opens selected eggs automatically
  - Opens maximum amount per execution
  - Handles pet auto-deletion settings
  - Works with any egg in any zone

#### Pet Crafting
- **Auto Craft All**: Automatically crafts all pets when enabled
- **Continuous Operation**: Runs every 0.1 seconds for maximum efficiency
- **Error Handling**: Graceful error handling with detailed logging

### ⚡ Performance Features

#### Optimized Execution
- **Fast Farming Loops**: Minimal wait times between actions
- **Cached Remote References**: Pre-cached remote events for faster execution
- **Efficient Zone Detection**: Smart boundary checking with geometric calculations
- **Parallel Operations**: Multiple automation systems run concurrently

#### Walkspeed Management
- **Automatic Walkspeed**: Sets walkspeed to 70 by default
- **Persistent Application**: Continuously applies walkspeed (games often reset it)
- **Character Spawn Handling**: Automatically applies on character respawn

### 🎨 User Interface

#### Modern UI Design
- **Nozomi UI Library**: Beautiful, modern interface with smooth animations
- **Tabbed Interface**: Organized into Main and Eggs tabs
- **Real-Time Updates**: UI elements update dynamically based on game state
- **Visual Feedback**: Clear status messages and logging

#### Smart Dropdowns
- **Dynamic Options**: Dropdowns update based on available game content
- **Zone Auto-Detection**: Dropdowns automatically update when zones are detected
- **Error Recovery**: Robust error handling for UI updates
